options.name: build_tag
options.description: The name of the "build" or "buildroot" tag. The latest builds in this tag will be available in the buildroot when you build an RPM or container for this Koji target. Example: "f34-build"

options.name: dest_tag
options.description: The name of the "destination" tag. When Koji completes a build for this target, it will tag that build into this destination tag. Example: "f34-updates-candidate"

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Koji target to create and manage.
